name: Pierre Troisgros
bio: French chef of Roanne. With his brother Jean he ran the Frères Troisgros restaurant and made the salmon with sorrel sauce, a sauce that the cook did not thicken with flour. Some critics call him a father of nouvelle cuisine.

milestones.event: The Frères Troisgros restaurant in Roanne won its second Michelin star.
The restaurant won its third Michelin star.
